data.gender_notes: Premkumar is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Premkumar is recorded with the meaning “Love God”. Premkumar is a Hindu name meaning “Love God”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. in_sanskrit.name: प्रेमकुमार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is full of love and devotion towards his younger brother or son.

in_hindi.name: प्रेमकुमार
in_hindi.meaning: प्रेम (प्रेम का शब्द, love, devotion) + कुमार (कुमार का शब्द, younger brother, son)
in_hindi.long_meaning: जिसका प्रेम (love, devotion) पूरा है कुमार (younger brother, son) के लिए.

in_tamil.name: பிரேம்குமார்
in_tamil.meaning: பிரேம் (பிரேம் இழித்தல், love, devotion) + குமார் (குமார், younger brother, son)
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஒவ்வோரும் பிரேம் (love, devotion) குளிகிட்ட விஷயம் குமார் (younger brother, son) என்ற மனிதன்.

in_telugu.name: ప్రేమ్కూమార్
in_telugu.meaning: ప్రేమ్ (ప్రేమ్ శోదోధేయళ్ళు, love, devotion) + కూమార్ (కూమార్, younger brother, son)
in_telugu.long_meaning: ప్రేమ్ (love, devotion) చేయిపోయే కూమార్ (younger brother, son) ఎన్నోపోయిపోయే జీవితపోయిద్దే మీదేపోయిద్దే మనీ���� sha.

in_marathi.name: Premkumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Premkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prem (Love) + Kumar (God's Son)

in_bengali.name: Premkumar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Love God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Premkumar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Prem (Love) + Kumar (God's Son)
